extension.description: Local PS2 decompilation workbench: C variant search, shared claims and byte comparison. No AI required.
command.compare: Compare the current draft with the original
setting.openAutomaticOnStartup: Show the automatic search panel when opening this workspace. Never starts jobs automatically.
setting.repository: Game repository inside this workspace. Empty: detect ps2decomp.json in an open folder. User-level paths are ignored.
setting.python: Python executable with the project dependencies. Empty: use the game repository venv.
